mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 74 degrees and overcast by the Verona Area High School. We are in a new moon phase tonight, and you can expect an overnight low of 66 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The Senior Center is seeking new volunteers to help keep programs running smoothly, and City Hall has officially released election notices for the upcoming August primary and November general election.

We have a busy weekend ahead. Today, catch live music at both Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or hear music at Paddy Mac's, and the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds is also coming up.

In a report covering August 3 to August 10, officers were busy with several calls, including an incident on August 5 where a man was taken into custody on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
